sources.title: GitHub - mx4ai/qwen2.5: Qwen2.5 is the large language model series ...
sources.snippet: Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5. Dense, easy-to-use, decoder-only language models, available in 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B sizes, and base and instruct variants. Pretrained on our latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18T tokens.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct: Open-Source LLM for Private Deployment & Custom AI ...
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct is a 7.6B-parameter instruction-tuned language model from Alibaba Cloud's Qwen team. It supports up to 128K token context length with 8K generation capacity, multilingual support (29+ languages), and has been optimized for coding, mathematics, JSON generation, and long-form text.

sources.snippet: Qwen2.5 is the latest series of Qwen large language models. For Qwen2.5, we release a number of base language models and instruction-tuned language models ranging from 0.5 to 72 billion parameters.
